free_tier.stated: RUB 5,000 of welcome bonuses for an individual account and RUB 12,000 for a legal entity, valid 60 days once credited. Of the RUB 5,000 for an individual, RUB 2,000 is usable on virtual machines and their backups and RUB 3,000 on other services; licensed products, the marketplace and CDN are excluded.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: RUB 2,000 of VM-only bonus at the Russian CPU rate is a few weeks of a 2-vCPU box, and the RUB 3,000 half cannot be spent on the VM, so the effective VM credit is 40 per cent of the headline.

limits.value: The bonus is conditioned on the account being registered from an IP address in Russia and on a corporate-domain email address being confirmed, so the individual RUB 5,000 lane is closed to a registrant outside Russia even though no passport is asked for.

notes: The useful number here is not the RUB 5,000 but the split: 40 per cent of the individual bonus reaches virtual machines. The startup grant is the large figure (up to RUB 2,000,000, with RUB 500,000 for months one and two and up to RUB 1,500,000 for months three to six) and it is entity-gated, so it is fails-identity with the number beside the reason. The IP-in-Russia condition is the constraint no identity document satisfies, which is unusual: most Russian providers gate on the phone, this one gates on the network.
